items.title: Three layers, one repo: a tour of google/adk-recipes
items.content: The google/adk-recipes repository unifies Agent Development Kit (ADK) resources into three structured layers—core/, plugins/, and contrib/—serving as a single source of truth for building AI agents. Developers can leverage reference patterns, install modular vertical skills (such as retail product search and virtual try-on) directly into their coding assistants, and deploy production-ready services across multiple languages. This cohesive structure streamlines the entire workflow from initial scaffolding to full deployment on Google Cloud infrastructure.

items.title: Announcing DPoP Support for Google OAuth: Securing Refresh Tokens
items.content: Google OAuth Platform now supports DPoP (Demonstrating Proof-of-Possession) to sender-constrain refresh tokens, neutralizing Infostealer malware and adversary-in-the-middle attacks. By cryptographically binding long-lived refresh tokens while maintaining short-lived access tokens as standard Bearer tokens, developers achieve robust credential security without incurring high-QPS API performance overhead. Additionally, developers integrating multi-agent or Model Context Protocol (MCP) workloads can use Google Cloud Secure Token Service (STS) to handle secure token delegation across agent chains.
items.contentSnippet: Google OAuth Platform now supports DPoP (Demonstrating Proof-of-Possession) to sender-constrain refresh tokens, neutralizing Infostealer malware and adversary-in-the-middle attacks. By cryptographically binding long-lived refresh tokens while maintaining short-lived access tokens as standard Bearer tokens, developers achieve robust credential security without incurring high-QPS API performance overhead. Additionally, developers integrating multi-agent or Model Context Protocol (MCP) workloads can use Google Cloud Secure Token Service (STS) to handle secure token delegation across agent chains.
items.creator: Google

summaries.zh: 谷歌OAuth平台现支持DPoP协议，用于约束刷新令牌，可防御信息窃取和中间人攻击。DPoP通过加密绑定长寿命刷新令牌，同时保持标准短寿命访问令牌，实现强安全性的凭证管理，且不增加API性能负担。此外，集成多代理或模型上下文协议（MCP）的开发者可使用Google Cloud STS服务处理代理链中的安全令牌委托。
summaries.en: Google OAuth now supports DPoP for securely binding refresh tokens to senders, mitigating Infostealer malware and MITM attacks. This cryptographically links long-lived refresh tokens while keeping short-lived access tokens standard. Developers gain robust credential security without high-QPS API performance costs. For multi-agent or MCP workloads, Google Cloud STS enables secure token delegation across agent chains.

items.title: Evaluating AI agents: moving past the vibe check
items.content: A practical engineering guide and reference architecture for establishing continuous evaluation pipelines for multi-turn AI agents using Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Google ADK, and OpenInference standards.
items.contentSnippet: A practical engineering guide and reference architecture for establishing continuous evaluation pipelines for multi-turn AI agents using Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Google ADK, and OpenInference standards.
items.creator: Google

summaries.zh: 本文提供了一种实用工程指南和参考架构，用于利用Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform、Google ADK和OpenInference标准建立多轮AI代理的持续评估流程。重点在于构建自动化评估系统，确保AI代理的性能和可靠性。
summaries.en: The article provides a practical engineering guide and reference architecture for continuous evaluation of multi-turn AI agents. It utilizes the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Google ADK, and OpenInference standards to move beyond subjective "vibe checks" and establish robust evaluation pipelines. The focus is on systematic assessment for improved reliability and performance.

items.title: Announcing MCP support in Apigee hybrid: agentic tools that run in your own cluster
items.content: Apigee hybrid 1.17.0 introduces native Model Context Protocol (MCP) support, enabling the MCP data plane to run directly within your own Kubernetes cluster. This architecture ensures that AI agent request traffic and tool execution remain entirely inside your infrastructure while pulling configuration updates from the control plane. Developers can expose OpenAPI 3.0.x specifications as discoverable MCP tools, leverage existing security policies and API products, and trace end-to-end requests using W3C trace context headers.

summaries.zh: Apigee hybrid 1.17.0版本引入了原生Model Context Protocol（MCP）支持，允许MCP数据平面直接运行在用户自有的Kubernetes集群中。该架构确保AI代理请求流量和工具执行完全保留在用户基础设施内，同时从控制平面获取配置更新。开发者可暴露OpenAPI 3.0.x规范作为可发现的MCP工具，利用现有安全策略和API产品，并使用W3C trace context头部进行端到端请求追踪。

items.title: Optimizing a 200,000-line Python codebase overnight with Gemini 4 Argon
items.content: How our engineering team ran Gemini 4 Argon unattended overnight with .agents/skills and /goal mode to cut in-memory session prep overhead by 40% in long sessions and speed up cold imports by 21% in Google's open-source Python Agent Development Kit (ADK).
items.contentSnippet: How our engineering team ran Gemini 4 Argon unattended overnight with .agents/skills and /goal mode to cut in-memory session prep overhead by 40% in long sessions and speed up cold imports by 21% in Google's open-source Python Agent Development Kit (ADK).
items.creator: Google

summaries.zh: 本文介绍了谷歌工程团队如何通过在开源Python Agent Development Kit (ADK)中不夜不眠运行Gemini 4 Argon，优化了20万行Python代码库。利用.agents/skills和/goal模式，内存会话准备开销降低了40%，冷启动导入速度提升了21%。
summaries.en: The engineering team optimized a 200,000-line Python codebase using Gemini 4 Argon by running it unattended overnight in /agents/skills and /goal mode. This reduced in-memory session prep overhead by 40% in long sessions and sped up cold imports by 21% in Google's open-source Python Agent Development Kit (ADK). The improvements were achieved without manual intervention.

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon for Robotics
items.content: Gemini 4 Argon is a general-purpose physical reasoning model designed to enhance workflows across the robotics stack with advanced capabilities in physical understanding, code generation, and visual-semantic reasoning. Developers can access and integrate Argon across Google's developer platforms—including Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, and Google Antigravity—to build and test sophisticated robotic applications. By leveraging simulation tools like MuJoCo and code-as-policies, engineers can seamlessly transition from real-world data or sketches to physically verified robot control and self-improvement workflows.

items.title: The Outer Loop, Insights First: An Ambient Quality Agent That Diagnoses Your Production Agent
items.content: How do you keep improving an AI agent after the first 80%, once it serves real production traffic and silent quality regressions return HTTP 200 OK? We are open-sourcing AQuA (Ambient Quality Agent), a reference implementation that runs beside your production agent in Google Cloud, sweeps and verifies failure clusters against conversation transcripts, and diagnoses root causes anchored to the exact deployed source snapshot.

We are open-sourcing AQuA (Ambient Quality Agent), a reference implementation that runs beside your production agent in Google Cloud, sweeps and verifies failure clusters against conversation transcripts, and diagnoses root causes anchored to the exact deployed source snapshot.
items.creator: Google

summaries.zh: 《外环洞察：一种环境质量代理，诊断您的生产代理》开源了AQuA（环境质量代理），这是一个在Google Cloud中运行于生产代理旁边的参考实现。它通过检查对话记录和失败集群来验证问题，并定位到具体部署的源快照，从而诊断根本原因。
summaries.en: AQuA (Ambient Quality Agent) is an open-source tool designed to improve AI agents after they reach 80% performance in production. Running alongside the production agent in Google Cloud, AQuA monitors and verifies failure clusters by analyzing conversation transcripts. It pinpoints root causes tied to specific deployed source snapshots, helping diagnose silent quality regressions that return HTTP 200 OK responses.

items.title: ML Drift: Next-Gen GPU AI/ML Inference at the Edge
items.content: Google AI Edge has introduced ML Drift, a high-performance, universal GPU compute framework designed to accelerate on-device AI and machine learning inference. By abstracting the complexities of hardware and low-level APIs—including OpenGL ES, OpenCL, Metal, and WebGPU—ML Drift enables developers to build real-time, interactive ML experiences, from sophisticated video effects to generative AI, across mobile and desktop platforms.

items.title: Supercharge your development with the Google Developer Knowledge API ecosystem
items.content: Google is launching the Developer Knowledge API and MCP Server in public preview. This new toolset provides a canonical, machine-readable way for AI assistants and agentic platforms to search and retrieve up-to-date documentation across Firebase, Google Cloud, Android, and more. By using the official MCP server, developers can connect tools directly to Google’s documentation corpus, ensuring that AI-generated code and guidance are based on authoritative, real-time context.

items.title: Bring multimodal semantic search to the edge with EmbeddingGemma 2
items.content: EmbeddingGemma 2 is a new 740M open-weight multimodal model that maps text, images, video, and audio into a unified vector space for privacy-first, on-device retrieval. Developers can easily integrate these capabilities cross-platform using MediaPipe Tasks or optimize fine-grained performance across CPU, GPU, and NPU accelerators with LiteRT. The model enables ultra-low-latency local solutions like search-as-you-type media retrieval, keyframe video moments finding, and zero-shot intent routing.
